name: p99_v0_visual_single_expert_pool
hypothesis: Frozen foundation-video representations may carry stronger and more transferable subject-disjoint knowledge than the closed Depth route, but all candidates must be re-evaluated under the new E0+H1 firewall rather than inheriting old H2/H3 decisions.
selection: No automatic winner. Build a Pareto audit over Top-1/Top-5, anchor rescue-harm, worst user, focus groups, and equal-budget Student transfer.
student_probe: Every non-dominated information-bearing visual expert uses the frozen P99 four-epoch Student protocol; no expert-specific Student tuning.
h2_policy: Only a recipe and Student target frozen from H1 may be confirmed once on H2. H3 has no code path.
